messages:
maria: Heads up — CI perf regression surfaced on canary after today's merge. p95 decode for small-batch (seq<=64) jumped from ~70ms -> ~190ms. CI run: https://ci.redwood/12345 :warning:

jason: ack. which PR/commit?

maria: PR #4821 / commit abc123. It changed the microbatch decision heuristic + the fused-attn kernel selector. Diff: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821

ben: saw the alert too. quick look at the flamegraph — lots more time in attn_transpose_kernel and memcpy during tail decode. Also a spike in KV evictions.

priya: can you paste the profiler snippet you saw?

maria: sure — profiler (canary vs baseline):
```
canary: {
  attn_transpose_kernel: 42.1%  <-- up from 8.3%
  fused_attn_fastpath: 12.0%    <-- down from 54.0%
  memcpy: 22.5%                <-- up from 3.2%
  kv_cache_eviction: 11.8%     <-- up from 0.9%
}
baseline: {
  attn_transpose_kernel: 8.3%
  fused_attn_fastpath: 54.0%
  memcpy: 3.2%
  kv_cache_eviction: 0.9%
}
```

perf-bot: Automated regression detector: p95 delta +120ms for commit abc123 vs baseline. Alert created RG-2026.

dave: thinking out loud — the heuristic in #4821 lowers the coalescing window for microbatches which increases small-batch frequency. That both reduces opportunities for fused_attn and worsens KV locality (more cold cache entries -> evictions).

jason: can we reproduce locally? try: `./tools/run_perf --model=gpt-small --seq=32 --batch=8 --seed=42`

maria: repro'd locally. tail of decode shows repeated KV_CACHE_MISS at steps 12-28, correlated with small microbatches. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20 09:12:34] STEP 11: KV_CACHE_HIT
[2026-03-20 09:12:34] STEP 12: KV_CACHE_MISS (evict candidate=0x7f...)
[2026-03-20 09:12:34] attn_transpose_kernel duration 1.8ms -> 6.7ms
[2026-03-20 09:12:35] STEP 13: KV_CACHE_MISS
```

ben: quick bisect options: (A) revert microbatch heuristic in #4821, (B) force old kernel selector (legacy fused_attn preference) via env override, (C) hotfix to increase KV cache size/TTL. Which is fastest?

priya: (B) first is least invasive — set KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy in canary and run. If that fixes perf, we can hold rollout and revert PR next. Also add a regression unit test for microbatch path.

maria: running canary with KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy now, will post results in ~20m.

(20m later)

maria: canary update: forcing legacy selector restores fused_attn_fastpath and p95 back to ~68ms. No KV eviction spike. Holding rollout and marking PR #4821 as revert-candidate. :raised_hands:

jason: thanks — please open the revert and block the rollout. Also file follow-up to refine heuristic and add perf guardrails.

ben: opened revert PR #4827 and issue #5124 for follow-up (microbatch unit test + eviction safety).

perf-bot: Regression issue created: RG-2026 -> linked to #4827 #5124.

priya: post-mortem action items: 1) add a small-batch perf test to CI that runs seq<=64 microbatch scenarios; 2) add a kernel-selection fuzz test that ensures fused_fastpath usage doesn't drop >30% vs baseline; 3) add KV eviction telemetry thresholds to alert earlier.

maria: added to #5124. Thanks everyone, let's keep the hold until the revert lands. :thumbsup:
